acro-bike.name: Acro Bike
acro-bike.short_desc: More maneuverable than the Mach Bike, and allows hopping along rails.
acro-bike.desc: Increases movement speed outside or in caves. Slower than the Mach Bike. Can perform various tricks, allowing the trainer to reach certain special areas.
acro-bike.flavor_text: This folding bike allows you to perform actions such as wheelies and bunny hops.

adventure-rules.name: Adventure Guide
adventure-rules.flavor_text: A compact device that automatically collects and records advice when a Trainer is out on an adventure.

apricorn-box.name: Apricorn Box
apricorn-box.flavor_text: A handy box where you can store up to 99 of each kind of Apricorn.

aqua-suit.name: Aqua Suit
aqua-suit.short_desc: Allows the player to ride Kyogre in the Cave of Origin.
aqua-suit.desc: Allows the player to ride Kyogre in the Cave of Origin.
aqua-suit.flavor_text: A suit made with the collective technological know-how of Team Aqua. It can withstand any impact.

armor-pass.name: Armor Pass
armor-pass.flavor_text: A pass to go to the Isle of Armor. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.

auroraticket.name: AuroraTicket
auroraticket.short_desc: Allows access to Birth Island and Deoxys.
auroraticket.desc: Provides access to Birth Island and Deoxys.
auroraticket.flavor_text: A ticket required to board the ship to BIRTH ISLAND. It glows beautifully.

azure-flute.name: Azure Flute
azure-flute.short_desc: Allows entry into the Hall of Origin. Unreleased.
azure-flute.flavor_text: A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world. No one knows who made it.

basement-key.name: Basement Key
basement-key.short_desc: HS: Key to the tunnel under Goldenrod City. Gen III: Key to New Mauville.
basement-key.desc: Used by trainer outside of battle : Opens the door to the basement tunnel under Goldenrod City.
basement-key.flavor_text: A key that opens a door in the Goldenrod Tunnel.

berry-pots.name: Berry Pots
berry-pots.desc: Contains four portable pots of soil suitable for growing berries.
berry-pots.flavor_text: Handy containers for cultivating Berries wherever you go.

berry-pouch.name: Berry Pouch
berry-pouch.flavor_text: A pouch for carrying BERRIES. It is attached to the BAGs compartment for important items.

bicycle.name: Bicycle
bicycle.desc: Increases movement speed outside or in caves. In high gear, allows the trainer to hop over some rocks and ascend muddy slopes.
bicycle.flavor_text: A folding Bicycle that enables a rider to get around much faster than a pair of Running Shoes will allow.

bike.name: Bike
bike.desc: A folding bike that lets the player travel faster.

bike-voucher.name: Bike Voucher
bike-voucher.short_desc: Trade in Cerulean bike shop for a Bicycle.
bike-voucher.desc: May be traded for a Bicycle.
bike-voucher.flavor_text: Take this voucher to the BIKE SHOP in CERULEAN CITY and exchange it for a bicycle.

black-apricorn.name: Black Apricorn
black-apricorn.short_desc: Used to make a Heavy Ball.
black-apricorn.desc: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Heavy Ball.
black-apricorn.flavor_text: A black Apricorn. It has a scent beyond ones experience.

black-mane-hair.name: Black Mane Hair
black-mane-hair.flavor_text: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests beloved steed, Spectrier. The hair is very smooth to the touch.

blue-apricorn.name: Blue Apricorn
blue-apricorn.short_desc: Used to make a Lure Ball.
blue-apricorn.desc: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Lure Ball.
blue-apricorn.flavor_text: A blue Apricorn. It smells a bit like grass.

blue-card.name: Blue Card
blue-card.short_desc: Keeps track of points from Buenas show.
blue-card.desc: Allows the trainer to answer the daily question on Buenas radio show. Records the points earned for correct answers.
blue-card.flavor_text: A card to save points for the Buenas Password show.

blue-orb.name: Blue Orb
blue-orb.short_desc: Summons Kyogre to the Embedded Tower.
blue-orb.desc: Causes Kyogre to appear in the Embedded Tower.
blue-orb.flavor_text: A shiny blue orb that is said to have a legend tied to it. Its known to have a deep connection with the Hoenn region.

camping-gear.name: Camping Gear
camping-gear.flavor_text: Everything you need to set up a tent and get cooking in a Wild Area or at a camping spot.

card-key.name: Card Key
card-key.short_desc: HS: Opens doors in the Radio Tower. Gen III: Unlocks Silph Co Doors.
card-key.desc: Used by trainer outside of battle : Opens doors in the Goldenrod City Radio Tower.
card-key.flavor_text: A card key that opens a shutter in the Radio Tower.

card-key--letsgo.name: Card Key
card-key--letsgo.flavor_text: A card key that unlocks doors in Silph Co.s head office in Saffron City.

carrot-seeds.name: Carrot Seeds
carrot-seeds.flavor_text: Seeds to plant in a field. The kind of carrot youll get is determined by which field you plant the seeds in.

catching-charm.name: Catching Charm
catching-charm.flavor_text: Holding it is said to increase the chance of getting a critical catch. Curiously, the charm doesnt shake much.

clear-bell.name: Clear Bell
clear-bell.short_desc: HS: Allows Kimono-girls to summon Ho-oh. C: Summons Suicune to the Tin Tower.
clear-bell.desc: May be given to the Kimono Girls to summon Ho-Oh to the top of the Bell Tower.
clear-bell.flavor_text: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing sound.

coin-case.name: Coin Case
coin-case.short_desc: Holds coins for the Game Corner.
coin-case.desc: Contains the Coins used by the Game Corner, to a maximum of 50,000.
coin-case.flavor_text: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It can hold up to 50,000 coins.

colress-machine.name: Colress Machine
colress-machine.short_desc: Wakes up the Crustle blocking the way in Seaside Cave.
colress-machine.flavor_text: A special device that wrings out the potential of Pokemon. Its an imperfect prototype.

contest-costume--jacket.name: Contest Costume
contest-costume--jacket.flavor_text: A very cool suit to be worn during the Contest Spectacular.

contest-pass.name: Contest Pass
contest-pass.desc: Allows the trainer to enter Contests.
contest-pass.flavor_text: A pass required for entering Pokemon Contests. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on its front.

coupon-1.name: Coupon 1
coupon-1.short_desc: The first of three tickets used to obtain a Poketch.
coupon-1.desc: One of three coupons needed to receive a Poketch.
coupon-1.flavor_text: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokemon Watch Poketch for short. Three coupons are needed.

coupon-2.name: Coupon 2
coupon-2.short_desc: The second of three tickets used to obtain a Poketch.
coupon-2.desc: One of three coupons needed to receive a Poketch.
coupon-2.flavor_text: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokemon Watch Poketch for short. Three coupons are needed.

coupon-3.name: Coupon 3
coupon-3.short_desc: The last of three tickets used to obtain a Poketch.
coupon-3.desc: One of three coupons needed to receive a Poketch.
coupon-3.flavor_text: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokemon Watch Poketch for short. Three coupons are needed.

crown-pass.name: Crown Pass
crown-pass.flavor_text: A pass to go to the Crown Tundra. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.

dark-stone.name: Dark Stone
dark-stone.short_desc: Summons Zekrom for the final battle against N.
dark-stone.desc: Summons Zekrom for the final battle against N.
dark-stone.flavor_text: Zekroms body was destroyed and changed into this stone. It is said to be waiting for the emergence of a hero.

data-card-01.short_desc: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first place overall in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-01.desc: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first place overall in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-01.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many victories you have had in the Pokeathlon.

data-card-02.short_desc: Records the number of times the trainer has come in last place overall in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-02.desc: Records the number of times the trainer has come in last place overall in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-02.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many losses you have had in the Pokeathlon.

data-card-05.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokeathlons Hurdle Dash.

data-card-06.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokeathlons Relay Run.

data-card-10.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokeathlons Snow Throw.

data-card-11.short_desc: Records the number of points the trainer has earned in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-11.desc: Records the number of points the trainer has earned in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-11.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many points your Pokemon scored in the Pokeathlon.

data-card-12.name: Data Card 12
data-card-12.short_desc: Records the number of times the trainers Pokemon have messed up in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-12.desc: Records the number of times the trainers Pokemon have messed up in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-12.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times your Pokemon failed in the Pokeathlon.

data-card-13.name: Data Card 13
data-card-13.short_desc: Records the number of times the trainers Pokemon have defeated themselves in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-13.desc: Records the number of times the trainers Pokemon have defeated themselves in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-13.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times your Pokemon impeded themselves.

data-card-15.desc: Records the number of times the trainers Pokemon have fallen in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-15.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times your Pokemon fell down in the Pokeathlon.

data-card-16.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokeathlons Ring Drop.

data-card-17.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokeathlons Lamp Jump.

data-card-18.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokeathlons Circle Push.

data-card-19.short_desc: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first place overall in the Pokeathlon over wirelss.
data-card-19.desc: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first place overall in the Pokeathlon over wirelss.
data-card-19.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many Link Pokeathlon wins you have had.

data-card-20.name: Data Card 20
data-card-20.short_desc: Records the number of times the trainer has come in last place overall in the Pokeathlon over wireless.
data-card-20.desc: Records the number of times the trainer has come in last place overall in the Pokeathlon over wireless.
data-card-20.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many Link Pokeathlon losses you have had.

data-card-21.name: Data Card 21
data-card-21.short_desc: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first across all Pokeathlon events.
data-card-21.desc: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first across all Pokeathlon events.
data-card-21.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you have won a Pokeathlon event.

data-card-22.name: Data Card 22
data-card-22.short_desc: Records the number of times the trainer has come in last across all Pokeathlon events.
data-card-22.desc: Records the number of times the trainer has come in last across all Pokeathlon events.
data-card-22.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you have lost a Pokeathlon event.

data-card-23.name: Data Card 23
data-card-23.short_desc: Records the number of times the trainer has switched Pokemon in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-23.desc: Records the number of times the trainer has switched Pokemon in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-23.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you switched Pokemon in the Pokeathlon.

data-card-24.name: Data Card 24
data-card-24.short_desc: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first in the Pokeathlon Goal Roll.
data-card-24.desc: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first in the Pokeathlon Goal Roll.
data-card-24.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokeathlons Goal Roll.

data-card-25.name: Data Card 25
data-card-25.short_desc: Records the number of times the trainers Pokemon received prizes in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-25.desc: Records the number of times the trainers Pokemon received prizes in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-25.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times your Pokemon won individual prizes.

data-card-26.name: Data Card 26
data-card-26.short_desc: Records the number of times the trainer has instructed Pokemon in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-26.desc: Records the number of times the trainer has instructed Pokemon in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-26.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you instructed your Pokemon.

data-card-27.name: Data Card 27
data-card-27.short_desc: Records the total time spent in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-27.desc: Records the total time spent in the Pokeathlon.
data-card-27.flavor_text: It holds Pokeathlon records. It is a card that shows how much time you spent participating in the Pokeathlon.

devon-goods.name: Devon Goods
devon-goods.short_desc: Contains mechanical parts to be delivered to Captain Stern.
devon-goods.desc: Contains a machine part to be delivered to Captain Stern.
devon-goods.flavor_text: A package that contains mechanical parts of some sort made by the DEVON CORPORATION.

devon-parts.name: Devon Parts
devon-parts.short_desc: Allows Captain Stern to set out on his expedition.
devon-parts.desc: Allows Captain Stern to set out on his expedition.
devon-parts.flavor_text: A case that contains mechanical parts of some sort made by the Devon Corporation.

devon-scope.name: Devon Scope
devon-scope.desc: Reveals invisble Kecleon on the overworld.
devon-scope.flavor_text: A special device made by Devon Corporation that signals the presence of any unseen Pokemon.

devon-scuba-gear.name: Devon Scuba Gear
devon-scuba-gear.short_desc: Worn by the player while underwater.
devon-scuba-gear.desc: Worn by the player while underwater via Dive in Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire.
devon-scuba-gear.flavor_text: A device made by Devon Corporation that provides oxygen to users during the use of Dive.

dna-splicers.name: DNA Splicers
dna-splicers.short_desc: Fuses Kyurem with Reshiram or Zekrom, or splits them apart again.
dna-splicers.flavor_text: A splicer that fuses Kyurem and a certain Pokemon. They are said to have been one in the beginning.

dowsing-machine.name: Dowsing Machine
dowsing-machine.short_desc: Use to find hidden items on the field. AKA Itemfinder.
dowsing-machine.desc: Used by trainer outside of battle : Searches for hidden items.
dowsing-machine.flavor_text: A high-tech machine that shows the location of invisible items. Its attached to the head when in use.

dragon-skull.name: Dragon Skull
dragon-skull.short_desc: Return to the museum in Nacrene City.
dragon-skull.desc: Only used as a plot point; this item is given to the player and taken away in the same cutscene.
dragon-skull.flavor_text: A skull of a Pokemon that was said to have braved the angry waters to fly around the world.

dropped-item.name: Dropped Item
dropped-item.short_desc: Returned to Curtis or Yancy as part of a sidequest.
dropped-item.flavor_text: The Xtransceiver found at the Nimbasa City amusement park. It seems it belongs to a boy.

dynamax-band.name: Dynamax Band
dynamax-band.flavor_text: A Wishing Star has been affixed to it. It lets out a light that allows Pokemon to Dynamax when at a Power Spot.

elevator-key.name: Elevator Key
elevator-key.short_desc: Unlocks the elevator in Lysandre Labs.
elevator-key.desc: Unlocks the elevator in Lysandre Labs.
elevator-key.flavor_text: A card key that activates the elevator in Lysandre Labs. It is emblazoned with Team Flares logo.

endorsement.name: Endorsement
endorsement.flavor_text: A letter of recommendation that youll need in order to participate in the Gym Challenge.

enigma-stone.name: Enigma Stone
enigma-stone.short_desc: S: Summons Latias H: Summons Latios.
enigma-stone.desc: When taken to the Pewter City museum, causes Latias or Latios to attack the trainer. The Pokemon to appear will be whicher cant be encountered roaming in the wild.
enigma-stone.flavor_text: A crystal ball that was excavated from the ground. Its a very beautiful stone that is covered with bits of rock and earth.

enigmatic-card.name: Enigmatic Card
enigmatic-card.short_desc: Unlocks Lookers motel room on Route 8.
enigmatic-card.desc: Unlocks Lookers motel room on Route 8.
enigmatic-card.flavor_text: A mysterious card. Written on it is a request for you to go to a guest room in an Akala motel on Route 8.

eon-flute.name: Eon Flute
eon-flute.short_desc: Summons Latias or Latios for a ride.
eon-flute.desc: Summons Latias or Latios for a ride.
eon-flute.flavor_text: A flute that can be used to summon Latios or Latias no matter where you are.

eon-ticket.name: Eon Ticket
eon-ticket.short_desc: Provides access to Southern Island and Latias or Latios.
eon-ticket.desc: Provides access to Southern Island and either Latias or Latios, whichever is not available roaming around Hoenn.
eon-ticket.flavor_text: The ticket required for sailing on a ferry to the Southern Island. Does Norman, the Petalburg Gym Leader, know a secret?!

exp-charm.name: Exp. Charm
exp-charm.flavor_text: A charm that increases the Exp. Points that Pokemon can get. A machine-like object is inside the charm.

explorer-kit.name: Explorer Kit
explorer-kit.desc: Sends the trainer to the Underground. Only usable outside.
explorer-kit.flavor_text: A bag filled with convenient tools for exploring. It provides access to the Underground in the Sinnoh region.

fame-checker.name: Fame Checker
fame-checker.desc: Records information on various famous people.
fame-checker.flavor_text: A device that enables you to recall what youve heard and seen about famous people.

fashion-case.name: Fashion Case
fashion-case.short_desc: Holds Pokemon Accessories for use in Contests.
fashion-case.flavor_text: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokemon to wear in a musical.

festival-ticket.name: Festival Ticket
festival-ticket.short_desc: Hosts a mission in Festival Plaza.
festival-ticket.desc: Hosts a mission in Festival Plaza.
festival-ticket.flavor_text: A ticket that allows you to host a mission in Festival Plaza.

fishing-rod.name: Fishing Rod
fishing-rod.short_desc: Allows the player to fish for Pokemon.
fishing-rod.desc: Allows the player to fish for Pokemon.
fishing-rod.flavor_text: A fishing rod made by Captain Lana. Cast a line over piles of underwater rocks to fish for wild aquatic Pokemon.

fishing-rod--galar.name: Fishing Rod
fishing-rod--galar.flavor_text: Use it by the water to fish up various kinds of Pokemon.

forage-bag.name: Forage Bag
forage-bag.flavor_text: A bag to carry ingredients gathered during Mallows trial in the jungle.

galactic-key.name: Galactic Key
galactic-key.short_desc: Grants access to Galactic HQ in Veilstone City.
galactic-key.desc: Grants access to Galactic HQ in Veilstone City.
galactic-key.flavor_text: A card key for disengaging the security systems in the Galactic HQ. Losing it can result in punishment, apparently.

gb-sounds.name: GB Sounds
gb-sounds.short_desc: Use to listen to GameBoy era audio.
gb-sounds.desc: Used by trainer outside of battle : Changes the background music to the equivalent 8-bit music.
gb-sounds.flavor_text: A music player that allows you to listen to nostalgic songs. Its operated with the flip of a single switch.

go-goggles.name: Go-Goggles
go-goggles.desc: Allows the trainer to enter the desert on Route 111.
go-goggles.flavor_text: Nifty goggles to protect eyes from desert sandstorms.

gold-teeth.name: Gold Teeth
gold-teeth.short_desc: The Safari Zone Wardens dentures. Trade for HM04 (Strength).
gold-teeth.desc: The Safari Zone wardens teeth, to be returned to him for HM04.
gold-teeth.flavor_text: A set of golden false teeth lost by the Safari Zones warden. They make his smile sparkle.

good-rod.name: Good Rod
good-rod.short_desc: Used to catch Pokemon in bodies of water.
good-rod.desc: Used to find Pokemon on the Good Rod list for an area, which are generally mediocre.
good-rod.flavor_text: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokemon.

gracidea.name: Gracidea
gracidea.short_desc: Changes an unfrozen Shaymin to Sky Forme in the day.
gracidea.desc: Used by trainer on a Shaymin : Changes the target Shaymin from Land Forme to Sky Forme. This item cannot be used on a frozen Shaymin or at night. Sky Forme Shaymin will revert to Land Forme overnight, when frozen, and upon entering a link battle. This item must be used again to change it back.
gracidea.flavor_text: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions, such as birthdays.

gram-1.name: Gram 1
gram-1.short_desc: Part of a sidequest to obtain TM89.
gram-1.desc: Give to the Wingull on Route 13, along with Gram 2 and Gram 3, to receive TM89.
gram-1.flavor_text: An important letter that Wingull delivers.

gram-2.name: Gram 2
gram-2.short_desc: Part of a sidequest to obtain TM89.
gram-2.desc: Give to the Wingull on Route 13, along with Gram 1 and Gram 3, to receive TM89.
gram-2.flavor_text: An important letter that Wingull delivers.

gram-3.name: Gram 3
gram-3.short_desc: Part of a sidequest to obtain TM89.
gram-3.desc: Give to the Wingull on Route 13, along with Gram 1 and Gram 2, to receive TM89.
gram-3.flavor_text: An important letter that Wingull delivers.

green-apricorn.name: Green Apricorn
green-apricorn.short_desc: Used to make a Friend Ball.
green-apricorn.desc: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Friend Ball.
green-apricorn.flavor_text: A green Apricorn. It has a mysterious, aromatic scent.

grubby-hanky.name: Grubby Hanky
grubby-hanky.short_desc: Appears in the Cafe Warehouse on Sunday; return to the customer with a Patrat on Thursday.
grubby-hanky.flavor_text: A handkerchief dropped by a regular at Cafe Warehouse. It smells faintly like a Pokemon.

hi-tech-earbuds.name: Hi-tech Earbuds
hi-tech-earbuds.flavor_text: Strange earbuds that allow you to freely control the volume of various sounds.

holo-caster.name: Holo Caster
holo-caster.short_desc: Displays cutscene conversations as the plot advances.
holo-caster.desc: Displays cutscene conversations as the plot advances.
holo-caster.flavor_text: A device that allows users to receive and view hologram clips at any time. Its also used to chat with others.

honor-of-kalos.name: Honor of Kalos
honor-of-kalos.short_desc: Does nothing, but signifies becoming Champion.
honor-of-kalos.desc: Does nothing, but signifies becoming Champion.
honor-of-kalos.flavor_text: A precious symbol that is awarded only to an individual who has done great things for the Kalos region.

iceroot-carrot.name: Iceroot Carrot
iceroot-carrot.flavor_text: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a field covered in snow.

intriguing-stone.name: Intriguing Stone
intriguing-stone.short_desc: Trade for a Sun Stone in X and Y, or Pidgeotite in Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire.
intriguing-stone.desc: Trade for a Sun Stone in X and Y, or Pidgeotite in Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire.
intriguing-stone.flavor_text: A rather curious stone that might appear valuable to some. Its all in the eye of the beholder.

jade-orb.name: Jade Orb
jade-orb.short_desc: Summons Rayquaza to the Embedded Tower.
jade-orb.desc: Causes Rayquaza to appear in the Embedded Tower.
jade-orb.flavor_text: A shiny green orb that is said to have a legend tied to it. Its known to have a deep connection with the Hoenn region.

journal.name: Journal
journal.short_desc: Records prior significant activities the player took.
journal.desc: Records some of the trainers activities for the day.
journal.flavor_text: A notebook that keeps a day-to-day record of your adventure so far.

key-stone.name: Key Stone
key-stone.short_desc: Allows the players Pokemon to Mega Evolve.
key-stone.desc: Allows the players Pokemon to Mega Evolve.
key-stone.flavor_text: A stone filled with an unexplained power. It makes Pokemon that battle with a Mega Stone Mega Evolve.

key-to-room-1.name: Key to Room 1
key-to-room-1.short_desc: Unlocks the door to Room 1 in Sea Mauville.
key-to-room-1.desc: Unlocks the door to Room 1 in Sea Mauville.
key-to-room-1.flavor_text: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.

key-to-room-2.name: Key to Room 2
key-to-room-2.short_desc: Unlocks the door to Room 2 in Sea Mauville.
key-to-room-2.desc: Unlocks the door to Room 2 in Sea Mauville.
key-to-room-2.flavor_text: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.

key-to-room-4.name: Key to Room 4
key-to-room-4.short_desc: Unlocks the door to Room 4 in Sea Mauville.
key-to-room-4.desc: Unlocks the door to Room 4 in Sea Mauville.
key-to-room-4.flavor_text: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.

key-to-room-6.name: Key to Room 6
key-to-room-6.short_desc: Unlocks the door to Room 6 in Sea Mauville.
key-to-room-6.desc: Unlocks the door to Room 6 in Sea Mauville.
key-to-room-6.flavor_text: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.

legendary-clue-1.name: Legendary Clue 1
legendary-clue-1.flavor_text: A clue about the King of Bountiful Harvests. Its written by Peony, and an old photo is attached to it.

legendary-clue-2.name: Legendary Clue 2
legendary-clue-2.flavor_text: A clue about the legend of giants. Its written by Peony and has unique drawings.

legendary-clue-3.name: Legendary Clue 3
legendary-clue-3.flavor_text: A clue about the legend of bird Pokemon. Its written by Peony and has a unique drawing.

legendary-clue-question.name: Legendary Clue?
legendary-clue-question.flavor_text: A mysterious clue that Peony seems to have dropped. Theres a photo attached to it showing a shining hole opening above the Max Lair.

lens-case.name: Lens Case
lens-case.short_desc: Allows the player to change their eye color.
lens-case.desc: Allows the player to change their eye color.
lens-case.flavor_text: A rather chic-looking case for carrying contact lenses.

letter.name: Letter
letter.short_desc: A letter to Steven from the Devon Corp president.
letter.desc: Contains a letter to be delivered to Steven.
letter.flavor_text: An extremely important letter to Steven from the president of Devon Corporation.

liberty-pass.name: Liberty Pass
liberty-pass.short_desc: Allows access to Liberty Garden and Victini.
liberty-pass.desc: Allows passage on the Castelia City ship, which leads to Liberty Garden and Victini.
liberty-pass.flavor_text: A special pass to go to Liberty Garden. Board the ship in Castelia City.

lift-key.name: Lift Key
lift-key.short_desc: Operates the elevator in Team Rockets Celadon Hideout.
lift-key.desc: Operates the elevator in the Celadon Rocket Hideout.
lift-key.flavor_text: A key that operates the elevator in the Team Rocket Hideout. It bears the Team Rocket logo.

light-stone.name: Light Stone
light-stone.short_desc: Summons Reshiram for the final battle against N.
light-stone.desc: Summons Reshiram for the final battle against N.
light-stone.flavor_text: Reshirams body was destroyed and changed into this stone. It is said to be waiting for the emergence of a hero.

looker-ticket.name: Looker Ticket
looker-ticket.flavor_text: A ticket that was handmade by Looker. Its decorated with a liberal amount of glittery paint.

lost-item.name: Lost Item
lost-item.short_desc: A Poke Doll lost by the Copycat who lives in Saffron City. Trade for a Pass.
lost-item.desc: May be traded to the Copycat for a Pass.
lost-item.flavor_text: The Mime Jr. doll that was lost by the Copycat.

lunar-wing.name: Lunar Wing
lunar-wing.short_desc: Cures sailors son of nightmares in Canalave City.
lunar-wing.desc: Cures the sailors son of his nightmares; no reward, only a side effect of seeing Cresselia.
lunar-wing.flavor_text: A feather that glows like the moon. Its said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.

mach-bike.name: Mach Bike
mach-bike.short_desc: Faster than the Acro Bike, and can ride up sandy slopes and across cracked floors.
mach-bike.desc: Increases movement speed outside or in caves. Faster than the Acro Bike. Allows the trainer to ascend muddy slopes.
mach-bike.flavor_text: This folding bike more than doubles your movement speed.

machine-part.name: Machine Part
machine-part.short_desc: Must be replaced in the Power Plant to power the Magnet Train.
machine-part.desc: Must be replaced in the Kanto Power Plant to power the Magnet Train.
machine-part.flavor_text: An important part of a machine that was stolen from the Power Plant.

magma-emblem.name: Magma Emblem
magma-emblem.short_desc: Provides access to the Team Magma Hideout in the Jagged Pass.
magma-emblem.desc: Provides access to the Magma Hideout in the Jagged Pass.
magma-emblem.flavor_text: A medal-like item in the same shape as TEAM MAGMAs mark.

magma-stone.name: Magma Stone
magma-stone.desc: Causes Heatran to appear at Reversal Mountain. Unused prior to Black and White 2.
magma-stone.flavor_text: A stone formed by boulders melting in intensely hot magma, then hardening. Magma remains sealed inside it.

magma-suit.name: Magma Suit
magma-suit.short_desc: Allows the player to ride Groudon in the Cave of Origin.
magma-suit.desc: Allows the player to ride Groudon in the Cave of Origin.
magma-suit.flavor_text: A suit made with the collective technological know-how of Team Magma. It can withstand any impact.

makeup-bag.name: Makeup Bag
makeup-bag.short_desc: Allows the player to change their lipstick color.
makeup-bag.desc: Allows the player to change their lipstick color.
makeup-bag.flavor_text: A rather chic-looking case for carrying lipsticks.

mark-charm.name: Mark Charm
mark-charm.flavor_text: A mysterious and unique charm that increases the chance of finding a Pokemon with a mark.

medal-box.name: Medal Box
medal-box.short_desc: Holds medals recieved in the medal rally.
medal-box.flavor_text: A box-shaped machine that stores Medals and Medal information.

mega-bracelet.name: Mega Bracelet
mega-bracelet.short_desc: Allows the players Pokemon to Mega Evolve.
mega-bracelet.desc: Allows the players Pokemon to Mega Evolve.
mega-bracelet.flavor_text: This cuff contains an untold power that somehow enables Pokemon carrying a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.

mega-ring.name: Mega Ring
mega-ring.short_desc: Allows the players Pokemon to Mega Evolve.
mega-ring.desc: Allows the players Pokemon to Mega Evolve.
mega-ring.flavor_text: This ring contains an untold power that somehow enables Pokemon carrying Mega Stones to Mega Evolve in battle.

member-card.name: Member Card
member-card.short_desc: Allows access to Newmoon Island and Darkrai.
member-card.desc: Provides access to Newmoon Island and Darkrai.
member-card.flavor_text: A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 50 years ago.

meteorite.name: Meteorite
meteorite.short_desc: FL: Deliver to Lostelles father. RSE: Trade to Professor Cozmo for TM27 (Return).
meteorite.desc: RSE: May be traded to Professor Cozmo for TM27. FRLG: A meteorite to be delivered to Lostelles father.
meteorite.flavor_text: A Meteorite originally found at Meteor Falls. You got it at Mt. Chimney.

meteorite-shard.name: Meteorite Shard
meteorite-shard.short_desc: Causes the Meteorite to transform to its final form, allowing Rayquaza to Mega Evolve.
meteorite-shard.desc: Causes the Meteorite to transform to its final form, allowing Rayquaza to Mega Evolve.
meteorite-shard.flavor_text: One of the fragments of a Meteorite from Granite Cave. Its faintly warm to the touch.

moon-flute.name: Moon Flute
moon-flute.short_desc: Evolves Nebby into Lunala when used at the Altar of the Moone.
moon-flute.desc: Evolves Nebby into Lunala when used at the Altar of the Moone.
moon-flute.flavor_text: It is said that the tones it produces were offered up as an expression of gratitude to the Legendary Pokemon of the moon.

mystery-egg.name: Mystery Egg
mystery-egg.desc: Must be obtained to trigger the break-in at Professor Elms lab, the first rival battle, and access to Route 31.
mystery-egg.flavor_text: A mysterious Egg obtained from Mr. Pokemon. What is in the Egg is unknown.

mysticticket.name: MysticTicket
mysticticket.short_desc: Allows access to Navel Rock and Lugia or Ho-oh.
mysticticket.desc: Provides access to Navel Rock, Ho-Oh, and Lugia.
mysticticket.flavor_text: A ticket required to board the ship to NAVEL ROCK. It glows with a mystic light.

oaks-letter.name: Oaks Letter
oaks-letter.short_desc: Allows access to Seabreak path, Flower Paradise, and Shaymin.
oaks-letter.desc: Grants access to Flower Paradise and Shaymin.
oaks-letter.flavor_text: A letter from Professor Oak. Written in it is a request for you to go to Route 224.

oaks-parcel.name: Oaks Parcel
oaks-parcel.short_desc: Trade to Prof. Oak for a Pokedex.
oaks-parcel.desc: A parcel to be delivered to Professor Oak for a Pokedex.
oaks-parcel.flavor_text: A parcel to be delivered to PROF. OAK from VIRIDIAN CITYs POKeMON MART.

old-charm.name: Old Charm
old-charm.short_desc: Trade to Cynthias grandmother in Celestic Town for HM04 (Surf).
old-charm.desc: Given to Cynthias grandmother to get the Surf HM.
old-charm.flavor_text: An ancient good-luck charm made of Pokemon bones to be taken to the elder of Celestic Town.

old-letter.name: Old Letter
old-letter.flavor_text: A letter entrusted to you by a girl, to be delivered to a boy. Strangely, it looks old to you.

old-rod.name: Old Rod
old-rod.desc: An old and worn fishing rod used to fish for Pokemon.
old-rod.flavor_text: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokemon.

old-sea-map.name: Old Sea Map
old-sea-map.short_desc: Allows access to Faraway Island and Mew. Unreleased outside of Japan.
old-sea-map.desc: Provides access to Faraway Island and Mew.
old-sea-map.flavor_text: A faded sea chart that shows the way to a certain island.

oval-charm.name: Oval Charm
oval-charm.short_desc: Doubles the chance of two Pokemon producing an egg at the daycare every 255 steps.
oval-charm.flavor_text: An oval charm said to increase the chance of Pokemon Eggs being found at the Nursery.

pair-of-tickets.name: Pair of Tickets
pair-of-tickets.short_desc: Allows the player and their mother to see the star show in the Mossdeep Space Center.
pair-of-tickets.desc: Allows the player and their mother to see the star show in the Mossdeep Space Center.
pair-of-tickets.flavor_text: Tickets for two to the astronomical show being held at the Mossdeep Space Center.

pal-pad.name: Pal Pad
pal-pad.short_desc: Use to record Friend Codes and check your own.
pal-pad.desc: Contains friend codes for up to 32 other players, as well as their sprite, gender, and basic statistics for those that have been seen on WFC.
pal-pad.flavor_text: A convenient notepad that is used to register your friends and friend codes and keep a record of your gameplay.

parcel.name: Parcel
parcel.short_desc: Given to the trainers rival in Jubilife City. Contains Town Maps.
parcel.desc: Given to the trainers rival in Jubilife City. Contains two Town Maps, one of which is given to the trainer upon delivery.
parcel.flavor_text: A parcel entrusted into your care. Youre supposed to deliver it to your childhood friend who left Twinleaf Town.

parcel--letsgo.name: Parcel
parcel--letsgo.flavor_text: A parcel to be delivered to Professor Oak from Viridian Citys Poke Mart.

pass.name: Pass
pass.short_desc: Grants access to ride the Magnet Train between Goldenrod City and Saffron City.
pass.desc: Allows the trainer to ride the Magnet Train between Goldenrod City and Saffron City.
pass.flavor_text: A pass required for riding the Magnet Train. It allows you to ride whenever and however much youd like.

permit.name: Permit
permit.short_desc: Grants access to the Nature Preserve.
permit.flavor_text: A permit that is needed to enter the Nature Preserve. Not many know about it.

pink-apricorn.name: Pink Apricorn
pink-apricorn.short_desc: Used to make a Love Ball.
pink-apricorn.desc: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Love Ball.
pink-apricorn.flavor_text: A pink Apricorn. It has a nice, sweet scent.

plasma-card.name: Plasma Card
plasma-card.short_desc: Required to progress in the Plasma Frigate.
plasma-card.flavor_text: A card key needed to enter the password inside the Plasma Frigate.

poffin-case.name: Poffin Case
poffin-case.flavor_text: A case for storing Poffins cooked from Berries.

point-card.name: Point Card
point-card.short_desc: Keeps count of Battle Points earned.
point-card.flavor_text: A card that lists how many Battle Points you have earned.

poke-flute.name: Poke Flute
poke-flute.short_desc: Use to awaken sleeping Pokemon, including Snorlax on roads.
poke-flute.desc: Wakes up sleeping Pokemon. Required to wake up sleeping Snorlax on the overworld.
poke-flute.flavor_text: A flute that can play with such a beautiful tone that even sleeping Pokemon find themselves woken up.

poke-radar.name: Poke Radar
poke-radar.short_desc: Use to track down rare or shiny Pokemon. 50 steps to recharge.
poke-radar.desc: Designates several nearby patches of grass as containing Pokemon, some of which may be special radar-only Pokemon. Successive uses in a certain way create chains of encounters with the same species; longer chains increase the chance that a shiny Pokemon of that species will appear.
poke-radar.flavor_text: A tool that can search out Pokemon that are hiding in the tall grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.

pokeblock-case.name: Pokeblock Case
pokeblock-case.flavor_text: A case for holding POKeBLOCKS made with a BERRY BLENDER. It releases one POKeBLOCK when shaken.

pokeblock-kit.name: Pokeblock Kit
pokeblock-kit.flavor_text: A set containing a Berry Blender for making Pokeblocks and a Pokeblock Case for storing Pokeblocks.

pokemon-box-link.name: Pokemon Box Link
pokemon-box-link.flavor_text: A device that allows you to access the Pokemon storage system. There are some places where it wont work.

powder-jar.name: Powder Jar
powder-jar.short_desc: Stores Berry Powder made using a Berry Crusher.
powder-jar.desc: Holds Berry Powder from Berry Crushing.
powder-jar.flavor_text: A jar for storing BERRY POWDER made using a BERRY CRUSHER.

power-plant-pass.name: Power Plant Pass
power-plant-pass.short_desc: Permits entry to the Kalos Power Plant.
power-plant-pass.desc: Permits entry to the Kalos Power Plant.
power-plant-pass.flavor_text: This pass serves as an ID card for gaining access to the Power Plant that lies along Route 13.

prison-bottle.name: Prison Bottle
prison-bottle.short_desc: Transforms Hoopa into its Unbound form for up to three days.
prison-bottle.desc: Transforms Hoopa into its Unbound form for up to three days.
prison-bottle.flavor_text: A bottle believed to have been used to seal away the power of a certain Pokemon long, long ago.

professors-mask.name: Professors Mask
professors-mask.flavor_text: The mask that belongs to The Masked Royal. This pro wrestler apparently sews his mask on a machine himself.

profs-letter.name: Profs Letter
profs-letter.short_desc: Traded to the players mom for the Town Map and a Potion.
profs-letter.desc: Traded to the players mom for the Town Map and a Potion.
profs-letter.flavor_text: A letter that Professor Sycamore wrote to your mother. A faint but pleasant perfume seems to cling to the paper.

prop-case.name: Prop Case
prop-case.short_desc: Stores props for the Pokemon Musical.
prop-case.desc: Stores props for the Pokemon Musical.
prop-case.flavor_text: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokemon to wear in a musical.

radiant-petal.name: Radiant Petal
radiant-petal.flavor_text: A single petal that the King of Bountiful Harvests gave you. It radiates faint light.

rage-candy-bar.name: Rage Candy Bar
rage-candy-bar.short_desc: HS: Traded for TM64. Gen II & Gen V: Acts as a Potion.
rage-candy-bar.desc: May be traded for a TM64 in the vertical Underground Path.
rage-candy-bar.flavor_text: Mahogany Towns famous candy. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokemon.

rainbow-pass.name: Rainbow Pass
rainbow-pass.short_desc: Grants access to all of the Sevii Islands.
rainbow-pass.desc: Provides access to the Sevii Islands.
rainbow-pass.flavor_text: A pass for ferries between VERMILION and the SEVII ISLANDS. It features a drawing of a rainbow.

rainbow-wing.name: Rainbow Wing
rainbow-wing.short_desc: Summons Ho-Oh at the top of the Bell Tower.
rainbow-wing.desc: Causes Ho-Oh to appear at the top of Bell Tower.
rainbow-wing.flavor_text: A mystical rainbow feather that sparkles.

red-apricorn.name: Red Apricorn
red-apricorn.short_desc: Used to make a Level Ball.
red-apricorn.desc: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Level Ball.
red-apricorn.flavor_text: A red Apricorn. It assails your nostrils.

red-orb.name: Red Orb
red-orb.short_desc: Summons Groudon to the Embedded Tower.
red-orb.desc: Causes Groudon to appear in the Embedded Tower.
red-orb.flavor_text: A shiny red orb that is said to have a legend tied to it. Its known to have a deep connection with the Hoenn region.

red-scale.name: Red Scale
red-scale.short_desc: Trade to Mr. Pokemon for an Exp. Share.
red-scale.desc: May be traded to Mr. Pokemon for an Exp. Share.
red-scale.flavor_text: A scale from a red Gyarados. It glows red like a flame.

reins-of-unity.name: Reins of Unity
reins-of-unity.flavor_text: Cords that shine when you hold them up to the light. The people of old times presented these to the King of Bountiful Harvests to express their gratitude.

reveal-glass.name: Reveal Glass
reveal-glass.short_desc: Switches Tornadus, Thundurus, and Landorus between Incarnate and Therian Forme.
reveal-glass.flavor_text: A looking glass that reveals the truth. Its a mysterious glass that returns a Pokemon to its original shape.

rm-1-key.name: Rm. 1 Key
rm-1-key.short_desc: Unlocks room 1 on the Abandoned Ship.
rm-1-key.desc: Unlocks room 1 on the Abandoned Ship.
rm-1-key.flavor_text: A key that opens the door to Room 1 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

rm-2-key.name: Rm. 2 Key
rm-2-key.short_desc: Unlocks room 2 on the Abandoned Ship.
rm-2-key.desc: Unlocks room 2 on the Abandoned Ship.
rm-2-key.flavor_text: A key that opens the door to Room 2 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

rm-4-key.name: Rm. 4 Key
rm-4-key.short_desc: Unlocks room 4 on the Abandoned Ship.
rm-4-key.desc: Unlocks room 4 on the Abandoned Ship.
rm-4-key.flavor_text: A key that opens the door to Room 4 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

rm-6-key.name: Rm. 6 Key
rm-6-key.short_desc: Unlocks room 6 on the Abandoned Ship.
rm-6-key.desc: Unlocks room 6 on the Abandoned Ship.
rm-6-key.flavor_text: A key that opens the door to Room 6 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

roller-skates.name: Roller Skates
roller-skates.short_desc: Allows the player to move quickly and off the grid.
roller-skates.desc: Allows the player to move quickly and off the grid.
roller-skates.flavor_text: Attaches roller skates to the bottom of your shoes, allowing you to glide quickly around and perform tricks.

rotom-bike.name: Rotom Bike
rotom-bike.flavor_text: This bike can be combined with the Pokemon Rotom to use a turbo boost.

rotom-catalog.name: Rotom Catalog
rotom-catalog.flavor_text: A catalog of devices that Rotom like. Use the catalog to have Rotom hop in and out of the various devices listed within.

ruby.name: Ruby
ruby.short_desc: Give to Celio with Sapphire to activate Network Machine and get Rainbow Pass.
ruby.desc: Deliver to Celio for use in the Network Machine.
ruby.flavor_text: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a red glow. It symbolizes passion.

sapphire.name: Sapphire
sapphire.short_desc: Give to Celio with Ruby to activate Network Machine and get Rainbow Pass.
sapphire.desc: Deliver to Celio for use in the Network Machine.
sapphire.flavor_text: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a blue glow. It symbolizes honesty.

scanner.name: Scanner
scanner.short_desc: Trade to Captain Stern for a DeepSeaTooth or DeepSeaScale.
scanner.desc: May be traded to Captain Stern for a Deep Sea Tooth or a Deep Sea Scale.
scanner.flavor_text: A device found inside Sea Mauville.

seal-case.name: Seal Case
seal-case.short_desc: Stores Seals that can be applied to Poke Ball capsules.
seal-case.desc: Contains Seals used for decorating Pokeballs.
seal-case.flavor_text: A case for storing Seals that can be applied to the exteriors of Poke Balls.

secret-key.name: Secret Key
secret-key.short_desc: Gen IV: The key to Rotoms appliance room. Gen III: The key to Cinnabar Gym.
secret-key.desc: Used by trainer in the Galactic Eterna Building, on the ground floor, to the left of the TV : Unlocks the secret Rotom room, in which there are five appliances which can change Rotoms form.
secret-key.flavor_text: A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electronic signal to open a door.

secret-key--letsgo.name: Secret Key
secret-key--letsgo.flavor_text: The key that unlocks the front door of the Pokemon Gym on Cinnabar Island. It has a red decoration.

secret-potion.name: Secret Potion
secret-potion.short_desc: Used to heal the Ampharos at the top of Olivine Lighthouse.
secret-potion.desc: Required to cure the Psyducks blocking Route 210 of their chronic headaches.
secret-potion.flavor_text: A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokemon of any ailment.

shaderoot-carrot.name: Shaderoot Carrot
shaderoot-carrot.flavor_text: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a gloomy field.

shiny-charm.name: Shiny Charm
shiny-charm.short_desc: Raises the chance of finding a shiny Pokemon.
shiny-charm.flavor_text: A shiny charm said to increase the chance of finding a Shiny Pokemon in the wild.

silph-scope.name: Silph Scope
silph-scope.short_desc: Used to identify the true forms of ghosts in Pokemon Tower.
silph-scope.flavor_text: A scope that lets you see what cannot usually be seen. It is made by Silph Co.

silver-wing.name: Silver Wing
silver-wing.short_desc: Summons Lugia to the Whirl Islands.
silver-wing.desc: Causes Lugia to appear in the Whirl Islands.
silver-wing.flavor_text: A strange, silvery feather that sparkles.

sonias-book.name: Sonias Book
sonias-book.flavor_text: Professor Sonias published writings. Her new discoveries about the Galar regions legends are recorded in this enjoyable read.

soot-sack.name: Soot Sack
soot-sack.desc: Collects soot when walking through tall grass on Route 113.
soot-sack.flavor_text: A sack used to gather and hold volcanic ash.

sparkling-stone.name: Sparkling Stone
sparkling-stone.flavor_text: A stone entrusted by a Pokemon that has been venerated as a guardian deity in the Alola region. There is said to be some secret in how it sparkles.

sprayduck.name: Sprayduck
sprayduck.flavor_text: A watering can shaped like a Psyduck. It helps promote the healthy growth of any Berries planted in good, soft soil.

sprinklotad.name: Sprinklotad
sprinklotad.flavor_text: A watering can shaped like a Lotad. It helps promote the healthy growth of any Berries planted in good, soft soil.

squirt-bottle.name: Squirt Bottle
squirt-bottle.short_desc: Use on Sudowoodo blocking the path on Route 36. Also waters berries.
squirt-bottle.desc: Required to water berries within the Berry Pots. Required to battle the Sudowoodo on Route 36. This item cannot be directly used from the bag.
squirt-bottle.flavor_text: A bottle used for watering plants in the Berry Pots.

ss-ticket.name: S.S. Ticket
ss-ticket.short_desc: Ticket for a ship. (RSE: S.S. Tidal LF: S.S. Anne HG: S.S. Aqua)
ss-ticket.desc: Allows passage on a ferry. The same item is used for different ferries between different games.
ss-ticket.flavor_text: A ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Aqua. It has a drawing of a ship on its front.

ss-ticket--letsgo.name: S.S. Ticket
ss-ticket--letsgo.flavor_text: The ticket required to board the S.S. Anne. It has a drawing of a ship on it.

storage-key.name: Storage Key
storage-key.short_desc: Grants access to the Team Galactic warehouse in Veilstone City.
storage-key.desc: Grants access to the Team Galactic warehouse in Veilstone City.
storage-key.flavor_text: The key to Team Galactics sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.

style-card.name: Style Card
style-card.flavor_text: A card that increases the selection in boutiques and hair salons.

suite-key.name: Suite Key
suite-key.short_desc: Opens a locked building in the Lakeside Resort.
suite-key.desc: Opens the locked building in the lakeside resort.
suite-key.flavor_text: A key to one of the suites at a certain luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.

sun-flute.name: Sun Flute
sun-flute.short_desc: Evolves Nebby into Solgaleo when used at the Altar of the Sunne.
sun-flute.desc: Evolves Nebby into Solgaleo when used at the Altar of the Sunne.
sun-flute.flavor_text: It is said that the tones it produces were offered up as an expression of gratitude to the Legendary Pokemon of the sun.

super-rod.name: Super Rod
super-rod.short_desc: Used to catch Pokemon in bodies of water.
super-rod.desc: Used to find Pokemon on the Super Rod list for an area, which are generally the best available there.
super-rod.flavor_text: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokemon.

tea.name: Tea
tea.desc: Used to bribe the Saffron City guards for entry to the city.
tea.flavor_text: Aromatic tea that has a slightly bitter taste. It soothes a dry throat.

teachy-tv.name: Teachy TV
teachy-tv.flavor_text: A television set that is tuned to a program with useful tips for novice TRAINERS.

tidal-bell.name: Tidal Bell
tidal-bell.desc: May be given to the Kimono Girls to summon Lugia to the top of the Bell Tower.
tidal-bell.flavor_text: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing sound.

tmv-pass.name: TMV Pass
tmv-pass.flavor_text: A commuter pass that allows the holder to ride the TMV between Lumiose City and Kiloude City at any time.

town-map.name: Town Map
town-map.short_desc: Use to see the overworld map.
town-map.desc: Displays a map of the region including the trainers position, location names, visited towns, gym locations, and where the trainer has been walking recently.
town-map.flavor_text: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows you your present location in the region.

tri-pass.name: Tri-Pass
tri-pass.short_desc: Grants access to the first three Sevii Islands.
tri-pass.desc: Provides access to the first three Sevii Islands.
tri-pass.flavor_text: A pass for ferries between ONE, TWO, and THREE ISLAND. It has a drawing of three islands.

unown-report.name: Unown Report
unown-report.short_desc: Keeps track of Unown types caught.
unown-report.desc: Lists which Unown forms the trainer has caught.
unown-report.flavor_text: A report of all the discovered kinds of Unown.

vs-recorder.name: Vs. Recorder
vs-recorder.short_desc: Records wireless, Wi-Fi, or Battle Frontier battles, and stores points.
vs-recorder.desc: Optionally records wireless, Wi-Fi, and Battle Frontier battles. Tracks Battle Points earned in the Battle Frontier, and stores commemorative prints.
vs-recorder.flavor_text: An amazing device that can record a battle between friends or the battles at certain special battle facilities.

vs-seeker.name: Vs. Seeker
vs-seeker.short_desc: Allows rebattling of on-screen trainers. 100 steps to recharge.
vs-seeker.desc: Reveals trainers who want a rematch, by showing !! over their heads. Each use drains the battery; requires 100 steps to charge.
vs-seeker.flavor_text: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. Its battery charges while you walk.

wailmer-pail.name: Wailmer Pail
wailmer-pail.flavor_text: This is a tool for watering Berries you planted to make them grow more quickly.

white-apricorn.name: White Apricorn
white-apricorn.short_desc: Used to make a Fast Ball.
white-apricorn.desc: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Fast Ball.
white-apricorn.flavor_text: A white Apricorn. It doesnt smell like anything.

white-mane-hair.name: White Mane Hair
white-mane-hair.flavor_text: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests beloved steed, Glastrier. The hair is strong and very flexible.

wishing-star.name: Wishing Star
wishing-star.flavor_text: A stone found in the Galar region with a mysterious power. Its said that your dreams come true if you find one.

wooden-crown.name: Wooden Crown
wooden-crown.flavor_text: A mysterious object made of wood. Part of it seems to be chipped. Maybe its meant to be part of something.

works-key.name: Works Key
works-key.desc: Opens the front door of the Valley Windworks. Reusable.
works-key.flavor_text: A large key for operating the doors of the Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.

xtransceiver.name: Xtransceiver
xtransceiver.desc: Makes four-way video calls. Used for plot advancement in-game, but also works with other players via the C-Gear.
xtransceiver.flavor_text: A high-tech transceiver with a camera function. It allows up to four-way calls.

yellow-apricorn.name: Yellow Apricorn
yellow-apricorn.short_desc: Used to make a Moon Ball.
yellow-apricorn.desc: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Moon Ball.
yellow-apricorn.flavor_text: A yellow Apricorn. It has an invigorating scent.

z-ring.name: Z-Ring
z-ring.short_desc: Allows the players Pokemon to use Z-moves.
z-ring.desc: Allows the players Pokemon to use Z-moves.
z-ring.flavor_text: A mysterious ring that enables Pokemon to use Z-Power. It requires both the willpower and the physical power of the Trainer wearing it.

zygarde-cube.name: Zygarde Cube
zygarde-cube.short_desc: Contains collected Zygarde cells/cores. Can teach Zygarde moves.
zygarde-cube.desc: Contains collected Zygarde cells/cores. Can teach Zygarde moves.
zygarde-cube.flavor_text: An item in which Zygarde Cores and Cells are gathered. You can also use it to change Zygardes forms.
